findings: Leslie Mehrhoff whole plant and panicle: tall leafy culms with long bending blades. Old single fan rejected; spring vegetative foliage excludes mature panicle. Current three-size pilots (seeds 1,4,7) and every panel of36-seed contact sheet visually reviewed. Tall leafy culms and long bending blades now distinct from short meadow grasses; 65–127 cm. Vegetative spring growth omits mature panicles; grazing/water placement remains game-side. Accepted as stylized spring source; variant endorsement remains a user decision.
